home.flyingpadDesc: A living platform for understanding, learning and creating music — built across software, media and interactive experiences.

work.flyingpadStatement: A platform built to make musical knowledge understandable without flattening it — combining pedagogy, software, audiovisual production and interactive experiences.
work.ownershipNote: FlyingPAD is not a demo around one skill. I own the product direction, information architecture, software and UI, pedagogical structure, audiovisual production and the path to delivery.
work.labStatement: A place for prototypes, interface studies and creative-technical experiments. Not every idea needs to become a product before it deserves to exist.
work.flow: Idea → intention → abstraction → system → medium → production → iteration.

visual.title: Visual Arts
visual.body: The first language was visual: composition, form, contrast and the habit of turning an intention into something perceivable.

audio.title: Music & Audio
audio.body: Creation became temporal and collaborative: composition, performance, teaching, recording, production and sound design.

web.title: Web
web.body: Interfaces added interaction. Websites became another way to structure information, create an experience and ship work to an audience.

software.title: Software
software.body: Programming expanded the vocabulary again: abstraction, architecture, data, APIs and systems capable of carrying increasingly complex ideas.

systems.title: Creative Systems
systems.body: The disciplines no longer sit in separate boxes. Software, music, image, video and interaction are materials selected according to what the idea needs.

profile.scopeStatement: I can carry a project from the initial idea and system design through software and UI implementation, AI-assisted image / video workflows, audio production and final post-production. I also use AI-assisted development as an accelerator where it makes sense; architecture, design decisions, integration and final review remain deliberate and developer-owned.

own.title: Own the whole problem.
own.body: Understand the goal, constraints and delivery path — not only the code in the middle.

structure.title: Structure before implementation.
structure.body: Model responsibilities and flows first; then choose the simplest structure that stays clear.

architecture.title: Right-size the architecture.
architecture.body: Use patterns when they earn their keep. Avoid ceremony for its own sake.

legible.title: Make complexity legible.
legible.body: Good systems should remain understandable — to users, collaborators and the person maintaining them later.

ai.title: Use AI as leverage.
ai.body: Accelerate exploration and implementation without outsourcing design, integration or review.

refine.title: Ship. Observe. Refine.
refine.body: Get a real version into use, learn from it, then polish what actually matters.

exp.satellitDetail: Frontend forms, backend data processing, API integration and delivery around Azure services.
exp.audioDetail: From brief to delivery: recording, editing, mixing, mastering and post-production.
exp.webmasterDetail: Client sites: hosting, CMS setup, administration and maintenance.
exp.audioManagerDetail: Stage management, composition, performance and music teaching.
exp.brandyDetail: Studio sessions, planning and broadcast production / post-production.
